gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundari: Thin steel rod seems bent into every Righteous letter, with bowls that swell to fill the line. Noto Sans Nag Mundari follows with half-unwrapped c and s shapes, and a lowercase that stands nearly shoulder to shoulder with its capitals.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-nandinagari: Righteous draws each curve as thick as any straight stem, so its headings feel punchy and playful. Noto Sans Nandinagari does the quieter job, keeping its short-ascender lowercase generous at any weight.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-newa: Rope-like and loud, then easygoing. Righteous keeps every stem, bowl and tail at one consistent thickness, while Noto Sans Newa follows with a clearly open e and tall lowercase counters that give the text room to breathe.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Noto Sans Nushu stands tall, its x-height towering and its terminals held far from the stroke body. Over a long passage that gives the text a modern, spacious feel, while Righteous stays thick and playful above.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Righteous looks drawn with a technical pen, steady and confident, with bowls that fill the line. Beneath it, Noto Sans Ogham brings wide gaps in the e and tall lowercase bodies that look surprisingly bold.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Playful but commanding, Righteous outlines every counter in one steady thickness. Noto Sans Ol Chiki holds its curve tails well back from the body, so words settle into solid blocks instead of ragged skylines.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-old-hungarian: Righteous gives stems and arches an identical thickness, so each heading looks bent from a single rod. Noto Sans Old Hungarian then brings large open counters in its tall a, e and s, staying legible even at tiny sizes.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-old-italic: Contemporary and compact, Noto Sans Old Italic leaves very little gap between x-height and cap height. And over a longer read, its well-separated curve endings keep the text moving, while Righteous outlines its counters in one steady thickness.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-old-north-ara: Righteous draws a constant-width line like a marker, and it earns its keep when the words are big and brief. Noto Sans Old North Arabian handles the rest with a dense, tall lowercase band.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-old-permic: Righteous ends every stroke at the same measured thickness, which makes it bossy and fun at large sizes. But shrink the heading, or enlarge Noto Sans Old Permic, and the rounded, open-sided body would start to steal the spotlight.
